standard: T-1727. The committed alternates of single structures, selected by ?structure=<id>&version=<label>. Fetched by the renderer only when the address asks for a version — never at boot — and each row swaps exactly one building of this scene for its alternate record and mesh. version=default names the canonical record.

bates_auction_room.label: fixture
bates_auction_room.summary: Test fixture for the version switch (T-1727): the default record copied unchanged, so the release smoke can prove that ?structure= and ?version= swap exactly one building. Nothing about the auction room differs; this is not an alternative reading of the evidence.
